vocabulary.meaning_en: a reason you give for something you did wrong
a wait; to make something late
vocabulary.example: There was a delay at the airport.
She has no fear of the dark.
My little brother is scared of dogs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a hat with a peak; (slang) a lie
a piece of cloth used to cover a hole
vocabulary.example: My jeans have a patch on the knee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to know the meaning of something
what you say when someone asks you something
something that says what you must or must not do

fine_lines.title: No fear vs no cap
fine_lines.explanation_ar: no fear تعبير بريطاني غير رسمي يعني 'بالتأكيد لا!' رداً على اقتراح. no cap عامية حديثة تعني 'بصدق، لا أكذب'.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'No fear!' (UK, informal) = 'certainly not!' when you refuse a suggestion. 'No cap' (slang) = 'honestly, I'm not lying'.

examples.sentence: Go swimming in that cold lake? No fear!
This is the best pizza in town, no cap.

fine_lines.title: Not a patch on vs not like the sound of
words: not like the sound of something
fine_lines.explanation_ar: not a patch on something تعني أن شيئاً أسوأ بكثير من شيء آخر (مقارنة). not like the sound of something تعني أن ما سمعته يبدو سيئاً أو مقلقاً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Not a patch on' compares two things: the first is much worse. 'Not like the sound of' = what you heard seems bad or worrying.

examples.sentence: The new café isn't a patch on the old one.

examples.word: not like the sound of something
examples.sentence: A three-hour meeting? I don't like the sound of that.

fine_lines.title: Say no more vs yes and no
fine_lines.explanation_ar: say no more تعني: فهمت تماماً ولا داعي لمزيد من الشرح. yes and no جواب يعني: صحيح جزئياً، الأمر ليس بسيطاً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Say no more' = I understand completely, no need to explain. 'Yes and no' = partly yes, partly no; it's not simple.

examples.sentence: You need help moving house? Say no more - I'll come.
Did you enjoy the trip? - Yes and no. The hotel was bad.

expressions.meaning_en: it must be done; no excuses or arguments
expressions.example: You'll do your homework before you play - no ifs or buts.
That was the funniest film I've ever seen, no cap.
This sequel isn't a patch on the first film.

expressions.phrase: not like the sound of something
expressions.meaning_en: to think something you hear about seems bad or worrying
expressions.example: Heavy rain all weekend? I don't like the sound of that.

expressions.meaning_en: I understand what you mean or want; you don't need to explain
expressions.example: You're hungry? Say no more - let's eat.
Changing a light bulb? There's nothing to it.

expressions.meaning_en: an answer meaning 'partly true and partly not'
expressions.example: Is the job difficult? - Yes and no.

grammar.title: Short negative answers
grammar.explanation_ar: في الكلام اليومي نرد بعبارات نفي قصيرة بدل الجمل الكاملة: No fear! (لا أبداً)، Say no more (فهمت)، Yes and no (جزئياً). ونستخدم don't في: I don't like the sound of that.
grammar.explanation_en: In everyday speech we often answer with short fixed phrases instead of full sentences: 'No fear!', 'Say no more', 'Yes and no'. Use 'don't' with the verb: 'I don't like the sound of that.'
examples: Do you want to come? - No fear!
I don't like the sound of that.
It isn't a patch on the old one.
